package.description: 為已知密碼的加密 PDF 產生一份日後開啟免密碼的副本

en-US.description: Create a password-free copy of a PDF you already know the password for.
en-US.longDescription:
For encrypted PDFs whose password you already know: pick the file, enter the password once,
and save an unlocked copy that opens without a password from then on.
The original encrypted file is left untouched. AES-encrypted PDFs are supported.
This is not a cracking tool — a wrong password simply fails; there is no guessing,
brute force, or bypass of any kind. Use it only on files you own and know the password to.
en-US.name: PDF Unlocker

zh-TW.description: 為已知密碼的加密 PDF 產生一份日後開啟免密碼的副本
zh-TW.longDescription:
對於你本來就知道密碼的加密 PDF：選檔、輸入密碼、另存，三步輸出一份日後開啟免輸入密碼的副本。
原始加密檔保留不動，產出是一份獨立的無密碼 PDF。支援 AES 加密的檔案。
這不是破解工具——密碼錯了就解不開，沒有任何猜測、暴力嘗試或繞過機制。
請只用在你自己擁有、且已經知道密碼的檔案上。
zh-TW.name: PDF Unlocker
